## Commercial Sun Shade SAILS & Structures

At Advanced Shade Systems we provide builders, architects, commercial businesses and local
governments with functional and effective sun shade and waterproof membranes that meet and exceed
their expectations.

We offer a wide range of standard and customised products ranging from wholesale shade sails and
permanent waterproof umbrellas, to purpose built shade sails and structures, car park structures and
more innovative products. Our success is not only attributed to the top quality products that we
offer, but also the personalised and dedicated service that we offer our clients, many of whom
return to us whenever they need to discuss a new shade requirement. The team at Advanced Shade
Systems will work with you from the design stage through to engineering, building approval,
installation and final inspection.

Unlike some other shade companies, we handle the entire process in-house, from design, fabrication,
installation to certification. We have all of our own equipment which we can pass on to our
customers in savings, plus gives our team a far greater insight and experience in the industry,
which is very important considering the intricate nature of shade.

Our website features just a small selection of the projects, products and services that we have been
involved with in the last 20+ years working in the shade industry. Contact us today to discuss a
shade solution that can be customized to your specific needs.

governments with functional and effective sun shade and waterproof membranes that meet and exceed
their expectations.

permanent waterproof umbrellas, to purpose built shade sails and structures, car park structures and

offer, but also the personalised and dedicated service that we offer our clients, many of whom
return to us whenever they need to discuss a new shade requirement. The team at Advanced Shade
Systems will work with you from the design stage through to engineering, building approval,
installation and final inspection.

Unlike some other shade companies, we handle the entire process in-house, from design, fabrication,
installation to certification. We have all of our own equipment which we can pass on to our
customers in savings, plus gives our team a far greater insight and experience in the industry,
which is very important considering the intricate nature of shade.

involved with in the last 20+ years working in the shade industry. Contact us today to discuss a

have been very patient and helpful throughout this whole process. Thank you!

The Gap Child Care Centre -- Melinda Isambert

What a wonderful job.  The club is over the moon with the quality of the shade structure that
Advanced Shade Systems has built.  Facebook comments are flowing fast with positive remarks about
the new shade and your companies name is very prominent.  Please pass on my thanks to all involved.

-- Mount Petrie Bowmen

Communications from the office was a plus, the faultless installation, fantastic re-laying of pavers
and clean-up, an overall great job, owner very happy.  Love the finished product.

Stokes Wheeler -- Peter Goodhew

Thank you for the confirmation of the completion of the job, The works look fantastic. I was onsite
myself yesterday & saw what a great job your guys had done. Thanks again for all the assistance.
Kind Regards,

The Pines Boulevard, Yeppoon -- Peter Morley

I visited the Mater Hospital site, shade sails look great, thanks for getting this over the line.

Project Manager - Digit -- Sam Lock

Just a quick message to say how happy I was with Pez And Donny for there help on the 

G8 at Arundel 

The works were done in such a professional manner and nothing was a drama for the Boys 

Wasn’t the easiest job with rocky conditions but the boys pushed through and got the job done on
time and still smiling.

I would have no hesitation in recommending you guys for future works or to new clients. 

Thanks heaps and look forward to working with you guys in the future. 

Regards 

Scott Angleton (site Manager)

Prime Build -- Scott Angleton

The shades look just fantastic.  We are very happy with them. I've never seen workers leave a job
site so clean and tidy. Not a stone out of place. They were just the best and I cannot speak more
highly of the two guys.  I have let everyone and anyone know what a good job your guys and company
have done. We have had so many great comments about the shades.  Melbourne Cup Day was made even
better by having patrons outside and under cover.  I will certainly recommend your company to
anyone.

Western Districts Community & Sporting Club -- Sheryl Dowley

I wanted to let your Company know how impressed we were with the quality of  work and service we
recieved from the two guys who came to install the shade sail and blinds.  They were polite,
considerate and even cleaned up after themselves which is a rare find with workmen these days.  We
are also really impressed with the way the blinds and shade sail look and how they function.

The guys who were here to install them ensured that their work and the product supplied was to the
highest possible standard and for that we are very grateful.  If you could please pass on our thanks
and appreciation for working around us, the children and the chickens and showing such consideration
for others, we would really appreciate it.

Thank you and kind regards

LORDS Little Wonders Kindergarten -- Teacher Director

Advanced Textiles Expo is partnered with Site & Stay, our official housing partner, for hotel
bookings. Only book through this trusted partner to secure your room and avoid third-party scams.

[LEARN MORE][47]

the developers shaping the next wave of textile innovation so you can stay ahead.

Membership is required.

# AMA AWArd

# AMA AWArd

[An award plaque with a black border and white background, featuring the text 'AMA' in light gray
and 'award' in black, adorned with a stylized gold leaf in the top right corner.]

AMA recognises the importance of our living environment and the urgent need for sustainable
practices in light of climate change and growing environmental challenges. Committed to a greener
future, AMA supports more sustainable and environmentally conscious construction.

The **AMA AWArd** celebrates excellence in sustainability and the responsible use of natural
resources, recognising outstanding achievements in **Ideas & design** or **projects &
products **within the field of **lightweight and membrane structures**.

[ Learn more about AMA AWArd ][40]

# Highlights

# 〰️

# Highlights 〰️

#### **Innovative Membrane Roof Structures for Paddle Courts**

Bringing together cutting-edge design and premium materials, AMA member companies are proud to
showcase a series of paddle court roofing projects across Spain—delivering both functionality and
architectural elegance.

These **membrane-covered roof structures** range in size from compact layouts to expansive **800 m²
installations**, meeting a wide variety of client needs. With a **minimum height of 6 meters** and a
soaring **central height of 11 meters**, they provide the perfect balance of space, airflow, and
visual appeal.

At the heart of this innovation is **Valmex Mehatop Type II** PVC membrane (900 g/m²), supplied by
**MehlerHeytex**, ensuring superior durability, UV resistance, and long-term performance.

This initiative is a testament to the collaborative strength of AMA:
* **CARPATEC** leads the project with expertise in **design, structural engineering, manufacturing,
  and installation**.
* **MehlerHeytex** provides **top-tier membrane technology**, trusted across Europe.

Together, they are redefining standards in sports infrastructure—proving what’s possible when
world-class design meets smart collaboration.

[A large outdoor sports facility with a tennis court surrounded by a netted fence and a covered
pavilion with a white fabric roof, situated in a residential area with apartment buildings nearby.]
[A greenhouse with a rounded, translucent roof and blue support beams, situated on a grassy area
with trees and a road in the background.]
[Indoor tennis court with a clay surface and a net, surrounded by glass and metal fencing, with a
curved roof overhead.]

#### **AMA’s participation at Textile Roofs 2025 **

**Thank You – Textile Roofs 2025**

We are truly honored to have been an **official partner** of the **Textile Roofs 2025** workshop
held at the **Aedes Architecture Forum in Berlin** from May 25–27.

This 27th edition brought together a remarkable community of architects, engineers, designers, and
researchers passionate about **membrane structures** and **innovative lightweight architecture**.

A special thank you to:
**Prof. Rosemarie Wagner** (KIT) – Scientific Director
**Dr.-Ing. Bernd Stary** (academus GmbH) – Event Host
All the speakers, participants, and co-organizers who made this event a true success.

Looking forward to 2026!

[Group of people standing outside the Aedes Network Campus Berlin under a large white canopy,
smiling and raising their hands for a group photo.]

### TENSILE FABRIC STRUCTURES BENIFITES

One of the most significant advantages of **Tensile Fabric Structures** is their flexibility in
terms of design and construction.

**Tensile fabric structures** are a fabric material that is stretched over a framework of poles,
cables, or other structural elements to create a lightweight, yet highly durable and visually
striking structure.
* **Durability:** **Tensile Fabric Structures** are highly durable and can withstand a range of
  weather conditions, including high winds and heavy rain. They are also resistant to fading,
  tearing, and punctures.
* **Design flexibility:** Tensile fabric structures offer almost limitless design options, making
  them highly versatile and adaptable to different applications. These structures can be customized
  to meet specific project requirements, including shape, size, and color.
* **Energy efficiency:** Tensile fabric structures are highly energy-efficient as they reflect
  sunlight and reduce the amount of heat absorbed by the structure. This can help to reduce cooling
  costs and energy usage, making them an eco-friendly and cost-effective alternative to traditional
  building materials.
* **Cost-effective:** Tensile fabric structures are often less expensive than traditional building
  materials, making them an affordable option for many projects. They also require less maintenance
  over time, reducing long-term costs.

### TENSILE FABRIC STRUCTURES BENIFITES

One of the most significant advantages of **Tensile Fabric Structures** is their flexibility in
terms of design and construction.

**Tensile fabric structures** are a fabric material that is stretched over a framework of poles,
cables, or other structural elements to create a lightweight, yet highly durable and visually
striking structure.
* **Durability:** **Tensile Fabric Structures** are highly durable and can withstand a range of
  weather conditions, including high winds and heavy rain. They are also resistant to fading,
  tearing, and punctures.
* **Design flexibility:** Tensile fabric structures offer almost limitless design options, making
  them highly versatile and adaptable to different applications. These structures can be customized
  to meet specific project requirements, including shape, size, and color.
* **Energy efficiency:** Tensile fabric structures are highly energy-efficient as they reflect
  sunlight and reduce the amount of heat absorbed by the structure. This can help to reduce cooling
  costs and energy usage, making them an eco-friendly and cost-effective alternative to traditional
  building materials.
* **Cost-effective:** Tensile fabric structures are often less expensive than traditional building
  materials, making them an affordable option for many projects. They also require less maintenance
  over time, reducing long-term costs.

# Tensile Structure India

Architractile Company is a leading provider of tensile architecture and fabric architecture
solutions in India. Our company specializes in creating innovative and sustainable structures that
are both visually stunning and functional. We will discuss the benefits and applications of tensile
architecture and fabric architecture in India.

Tensile architecture and fabric architecture are two innovative design approaches that are gaining
popularity in India. These techniques offer architects and designers the ability to create unique
and visually appealing structures that are both functional and sustainable.

Tensile architecture in India refers to the use of a tensioned membrane to provide structural
support for buildings and other structures. This approach is ideal for creating large, open spaces
that are both functional and visually stunning. Tensile architecture has been widely used in India
for various applications, including sports complexes, airports, railway stations, and shopping
malls.

One of the most significant advantages of tensile architecture is its ability to span large
distances without the need for internal support. This allows for greater flexibility in design and
the creation of open spaces that are not possible with traditional construction methods.
Additionally, the use of lightweight materials such as PVC or PTFE can reduce the overall weight of
the structure, making it more energy-efficient and sustainable.

design where weight can determine the form of the structure as well as its stability. It means that
a tensile fabric architecture structure elements carry only tension and no compression or bending.

large-span areas or distances. Tensile architecture solutions are most commonly used in sports
facilities, warehousing, large buildings, and exhibition events. Tensile stadiums, tensioned roof
structures, cable-suspended bridges, and cable-supported structures are the best examples to explain
fabric structures in architecture. Architractile has the best team of qualified and professional
tensile architects in India. Tensile architecture is known by various different names in India such
as tension membrane structure, tensile membrane structures, tensile fabric structure, thin shell
structure, tensile facilities, tensile building, tension structure, tensioned fabric structure,

metal. *

# Membrane Systems Europe B.V.

Membrane Systems Europe B.V. (MSE) is specialized in the production and installation of covering
systems for the international biogas market. The stakeholders of MSE have a combined experience over
100 years in the biogas market with installations worldwide.

Our sales agents and employees share the goal of ensuring that our clients are satisfied with the
information provided during the offer stage. They are committed to working closely with customers to
build trust and comfort with our organization. We also maintain contact post installation to make
certain that the client is absolutely satisfied with the service we provided.

## Why we can help you!

MSE roofing systems are subject to static calculations according to Eurocode 1 (Germany DIN 1055)
specifications. Products comply to the highest European standard tolerances including snowload and
windload. [Biogas domes][28], [double membrane covers][29], and high-point-membranes are all 100%
high-frequency welded. With clients increasingly requiring more size and pressures from gas storage
roofs, this method of welding provides increased strength and extended lifespan.  Our products can
also tolerate pressures up to 40 mBar and diameters up to 50 meters.

As a total system supplier of covers, gas pressure management and mixing systems and specialist in
this field, we can advise you on the best solution to meet your specific needs.

# Membrane Systems Europe B.V.

Membrane Systems Europe B.V. (MSE) is specialized in the production and installation of covering
systems for the international biogas market. The stakeholders of MSE have a combined experience over
100 years in the biogas market with installations worldwide.

Our sales agents and employees share the goal of ensuring that our clients are satisfied with the
information provided during the offer stage. They are committed to working closely with customers to
build trust and comfort with our organization. We also maintain contact post installation to make
certain that the client is absolutely satisfied with the service we provided.

[More information][27]

## Why we can help you!

MSE roofing systems are subject to static calculations according to Eurocode 1 (Germany DIN 1055)
specifications. Products comply to the highest European standard tolerances including snowload and
windload. [Biogas domes][28], [double membrane covers][29], and high-point-membranes are all 100%
high-frequency welded. With clients increasingly requiring more size and pressures from gas storage
roofs, this method of welding provides increased strength and extended lifespan.  Our products can
also tolerate pressures up to 40 mBar and diameters up to 50 meters.

As a total system supplier of covers, gas pressure management and mixing systems and specialist in
this field, we can advise you on the best solution to meet your specific needs.

**Are you ready for an inspiring meeting?**

[Read more][30]

### [Single membrane cover][31]

The single membrane cover structure is constructed from heavy polyester textile with a synthetic
coating material on both sides to reduce emissions.

[Read more][32]

Our double membranes allow more gas to be stored in your plant(s) and provides the opportunity for
you to control the amount of gas you are extracting.

* Designed for rapid construction & Lager Span for more coverage.

# Home

# International Tension Structures is a US-based specialty contractor of custom tensile membrane
# structures.

Our tensile membrane structures include moving and dramatic light-filled forms which are engineered
and constructed using a high-tech blend of structural and architectural steel and bold curving
fabric membrane panels. Whether it be for form, function or both, ITS is committed to developing
project-specific solutions that deliver extraordinary results for our clients.

Our approach to designing and building tensioned fabric structures is turn-key and blends cutting
edge technology with real world construction know-how. Our professional services include design,
engineering, fabrication and installation of custom & unique tensile structures. Our structures are
efficient, environmentally sustainable and provide solutions to UV and weather protection on
buildings and outdoor spaces which have long-lasting performance as well as innovative and inspiring
architectural forms.

We invite you to browse our website and review some of our selected projects. If you have a question
or a need, please contact ITS and allow us to demonstrate how our fabric architecture can benefit
you.

## FABRIC GRAPHICS…

Have you considered using graphics & print imagery on your fabric?

This can be an effective way to bring another level of art and aesthetics to your project.

Ask ITS about our Fabric Graphics services!

## RETRACTABLE STRUCTURES…

ITS offers a custom designed Retractable Structure for roofs, shade structures & other canopy
systems.

Like everything we do, the ITS Retractable Structures are custom designed and engineered for their
unique project and space.

Ask ITS about our Retractable Structures!

## DESIGN & ENGINEERING…

ITS provides professional design & engineering services to our clients.

From concept and design development to membrane selection, specifications, construction
documentation, engineering and structural analysis, ITS is here to support you.

Give ITS a call for assistance on your next tensioned fabric structure project.

# Home

# International Tension Structures is a US-based specialty contractor of custom tensile membrane
# structures.

Our tensile membrane structures include moving and dramatic light-filled forms which are engineered
and constructed using a high-tech blend of structural and architectural steel and bold curving
fabric membrane panels. Whether it be for form, function or both, ITS is committed to developing
project-specific solutions that deliver extraordinary results for our clients.

Our approach to designing and building tensioned fabric structures is turn-key and blends cutting
edge technology with real world construction know-how. Our professional services include design,
engineering, fabrication and installation of custom & unique tensile structures. Our structures are
efficient, environmentally sustainable and provide solutions to UV and weather protection on
buildings and outdoor spaces which have long-lasting performance as well as innovative and inspiring
architectural forms.

We invite you to browse our website and review some of our selected projects. If you have a question
or a need, please contact ITS and allow us to demonstrate how our fabric architecture can benefit
you.

## FABRIC GRAPHICS…

Have you considered using graphics & print imagery on your fabric?

This can be an effective way to bring another level of art and aesthetics to your project.

Ask ITS about our Fabric Graphics services!

## RETRACTABLE STRUCTURES…

ITS offers a custom designed Retractable Structure for roofs, shade structures & other canopy
systems.

Like everything we do, the ITS Retractable Structures are custom designed and engineered for their
unique project and space.

Ask ITS about our Retractable Structures!

## DESIGN & ENGINEERING…

ITS provides professional design & engineering services to our clients.

From concept and design development to membrane selection, specifications, construction
documentation, engineering and structural analysis, ITS is here to support you.

Give ITS a call for assistance on your next tensioned fabric structure project.

# Sustainable Tensile Structure Solutions

Using our 35 years of unparalleled expertise, all J & J Carter structures and products are designed
and manufactured using only the highest quality materials and technology making them sustainable,
durable and adaptable to meet any requirement.

[ discover more ][93]

### Leading Manufacturer of Tensile Fabric Structures

**We offer a comprehensive design, manufacturing and maintenance service of fabric structures, both
temporary and permanent.**

J & J Carter is a leading provider of tensile fabric structures, driven by technology, and powered
by years of experience. As a family-run structure manufacturing company, we have a reputation for
quality and innovation. From concept creation through to final installation, you will find us across
all types of sectors. With a great deal of experience and knowledge across the whole spectrum of
tensile architecture, our aim is to supply our customers with superior quality bespoke structures,
which include high-performance sports domes, industrial and event structures and environmental and
agricultural solutions.

#### Worldwide Delivery

## Your Trusted Tensile Membrane Structure Partner

Jutent (Guangzhou Jiute Tent Co., Ltd. ) is a factory-direct manufacturer of custom tensile membrane
structures. Founded in 2016, our in-house engineering team uses SAP2000 and Easy software to design
and deliver 420+ projects across 30+ countries — no middlemen, no markups.

#### Proven Experience

Founded in 2016 with 420+ completed structures delivered to clients in 30+ countries worldwide.

#### In-house Engineering

Structural engineers use SAP2000 & Easy software for precise force analysis and safe designs.

#### Worldwide Delivery

We serve contractors and architects in over 30 countries directly from our Guangzhou factory.

#### Direct Production

Our 8,000sqm facility (6,000sqm steel + 2,000sqm membrane) ensures full quality control.

# MATRA

Manufacturers and Tent Renters Association was started back in 1987 as a result of a few rental
companies and area vendors that desired to build a stronger relationship in the tenting industry
while helping to educate rental owners about safety and new products.

[Read More][26]

# THE TENT SHOW

The largest ANNUAL outdoor tent show in the US, featuring hands-on training, education, networking
and vendor displays.

[Read More][27]

# NETWORKING

Our network of industry professionals allows members to learn about new trends, share insights,
learn from one another and receive valuable mentorship from rental and vendor members - at The Tent
Show, Spring Training and throughout the year.

[Read More][28]
[ Previous ][29] [ Next ][30]

# Mission

The mission of MATRA is to uphold safe practices and promote the professionalism and integrity of
the tent rental industry, through education, networking and leadership development.

# What MATRA Means to Me?

"The networking, education and friendships I’ve made since being part of MATRA is second to none and
I always know I’m going to meet someone new, learn something new and reconnect with friends every
year."

- Carol Cundey, L&A Tent & Event Rentals

"MATRA has been an integral part of our business. In the tenting industry, MATRA has helped
develop my education of the industry, as well as networking opportunities and leadership."

- Keith Eismann, Keder Solutions

"MATRA is a big family that welcomes everyone to participate – it is an organization that is here
for you!"

- Keith Krzeminski, Shelter Structures America

"The MATRA community has been a resource for building my industry knowledge, network and confidence
in choosing the tent rental industry as my career path."

- Liz Davis, Sunbelt Temporary Structures

"MATRA provides the industry with a solid means of networking, education, and a web of industry
resources unmatched within any other organization.  MATRA members work together to achieve one
common goal of providing customers with the safest and most advanced party rental technology
available.  I have found that manufacturers and tent rental companies have formed a partnership
unlike any other in the party and event industry."

- Marc Smith, PHP Distribution

"MATRA has been a consistent source for learning all aspects of the tent industry, from those inside
the industry. Nothing compares to learning from others who work through the same struggles and
successes. Building friendships with those who relate to your day, and are eager to help when called
upon, is priceless. We build each other up to the benefit of industry, our clients, our staff and
ourselves."

- Melani Kodikian, A to Z Party Rental

Dubai, UAE

integrity.
July 22, 2023
Verified Purchase

Doha, Qatar
Non-Power Park

before our deadline, and the team provided excellent training on maintenance procedures.
June 10, 2023
Verified Purchase

Khalid Abdullah
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

May 5, 2023
Verified Purchase

Yousef Ahmed
Muscat, Oman

The amusement park equipment has operated flawlessly for 8 months with over 200,000 uses. Safety

April 18, 2023

February 28, 2023

Austin, Texas, USA

Shri Tensile Structure Pvt Ltd is a professional tensile structure manufacturer in Delhi NCR,
specializing in high-quality, durable, and modern tensile membrane structures, tensile car parking,
and tensile roofing solutions for commercial, industrial, and residential applications. Established
in 2023, we design, manufacture, and install customized tensile structures that combine strength,
aesthetics, and long-term performance. Our solutions are widely used in commercial complexes,
factories, hotels, resorts, warehouses, parking areas, and public spaces across Delhi NCR.

## Custom Tensile Membrane Structure Company & Engineering Expert

SkyTensile is a custom tensile membrane structure company and engineering supplier specializing in
PTFE, ETFE, PVC, and PVDF fabric systems

Headquartered in Shenzhen, our expert engineering team from leading design institutes operates a
5,000 sqm advanced manufacturing facility.

With 10+ years of experience, we have delivered 1,000+ large-span and stadium membrane structure
projects, covering over 400,000 sqm globally.

Explore our membrane structure applications across stadiums, airports, transportation hubs, and
industrial building envelopes

[ View Applications ][53]

## Tensile Membrane Structure Applications & Industry Solutions

From large-span sports stadiums and transportation hubs to commercial ETFE skylights and
architectural landmarks, SkyTensile provides complete tensile membrane structure solutions,
including engineering design, membrane fabrication, steel structure manufacturing, and global
installation support

[Tennis court tensile fabric roof and stadium enclosure design]

membrane structures

Durable tensile membrane canopies designed for retail malls, commercial plazas, walkways, and
outdoor public spaces.

[ View Solutions ][55]
[14000 sqm large span ETFE canopy roof structure at Hangzhou Xiaohe Park]

Iconic custom tensile structures and artistic shade sails that transform public parks, resorts, and
civic centers into visual landmarks.

[ View Solutions ][56]
[Bus rapid transit (BRT) station tensile membrane shelter]

Weather-resistant tensile membrane roofing systems engineered for airports, railway stations,
transport hubs, and public infrastructure

[ View Solutions ][57]
[PTFE-etfe Commercial Atrium Canopy]

## Global Premium Material Alliances & Engineering Integration

SkyTensile operate as a robust one-stop infrastructure provider. We bridge heavy manufacturing
capabilities with the world’s elite architectural membrane supply chain to guarantee maximum
engineering compliance, structural safety, and long-term durability worldwide.

**✓ Elite Supply Chain Integration:** Direct factory access to genuine international premium fabric
systems including **Serge Ferrari, Obeikan, Mehler, and AGC ETFE**. We optimize material selection
to precisely balance light transmission, fire ratings, and wind load demands.

**✓ True One-Stop Engineering Service:** We do not just supply raw fabrics. Our engineers handle
full-scale non-linear analysis, steel framework optimization, and high-frequency factory
pre-fabrication before secure global export.

structures globally.

conceptual ideas to life. Creating custom [PTFE-coated fiberglass membrane][29], [PVC membrane][30],
and [ETFE film][31] innovative roofing systems, canopies and skylights, our work ranges from festive
amphitheaters, functional building facades, sporting venues, transportation terminals to

signature designs to its customers.

これまで以上に必要とされている。

企む、建てる、運ぶ、集める、拡げる、つなぐ。

人と地球の可能性を最大限に拡張し、

    モノづくりと価値づくりを通じて、

全ての境界や限界を飛び越えて、
世界に新しい物語を届けることができるのだ。

やわらかに考え、しなやかに実行し、
したたかに成し遂げる。
持ち前の発想力と実現力で、

    臨機応変で、変幻自在。

    世界中に創る。

    技術とこころ。発想力と実現力。
    モノづくりと価値づくりを通じて、
    社会に新しいものがたりを提供する。

    * 大胆に発想する
    * 「前代未聞」に、ひるまずに挑戦する

MakMax TSP ACTIO][TAIYO GROUP MakMax TSP ACTIO]

私たちの目の前には、
未だかつてないほどのチャンスが、広がっている。

テクノロジーの進化は、私たちに、
こう投げかける。
「人間よ、もっと自由になれ、もっと楽しめ」と。

環境や社会の変化は、私たちに、こう求めている。
「もう一度、豊かな未来を創りだせ」と。

これまでも、数多のチャレンジや前代未聞を、
チャンスや進化へと結びつけてきた
太陽グループのDNAが、
これまで以上に必要とされている。

企む、建てる、運ぶ、集める、拡げる、つなぐ。
モノづくりと価値づくりのスペシャリストである
太陽グループだからこそ、
全ての境界や限界を飛び越えて、
世界に新しい物語を届けることができるのだ。

やわらかに考え、しなやかに実行し、
したたかに成し遂げる。
持ち前の発想力と実現力で、
人と地球の可能性を最大限に拡張し、
凝り固まった世界に風穴を開け、笑顔で包まれる、
あたたかなものにするために。

世界を、やわらかく。
未来を、あたたかく。
* * Purpose 社会や人々にとって、私たちはなぜ存在するのか *
    人と地球の可能性を拡張しつづけ、
    やわらかであたたかな世界と
    未来を切り拓く。
* * Vision 私たちが辿り着きたい近未来の姿 *
    臨機応変で、変幻自在。
    驚きと感動の溢れるコミュニティを
    世界中に創る。
* * Mission どんな大胆な活動や方法でビジョンにたどり着くか *
    技術とこころ。発想力と実現力。
    モノづくりと価値づくりを通じて、
    社会に新しいものがたりを提供する。
* * Value 私たちはどのように行動すべきか *
    * 大きな夢を描く
    * 大胆に発想する
    * 「前代未聞」に、ひるまずに挑戦する
    * 挑戦したからには、とことんやり切る
    * 仲間を信じる。掛け算で動く
    * 目の前にいる人を笑顔に
      することを忘れない

### そして雨を降らし、ひとつの街をつくる。

砂漠の中に造られた巨大な膜とひとつの街は、太陽グループが一丸となり、実現したい景色を描いています。
「街」はハードとソフトの掛け算から創られるもの。人々が、活き活きと暮らし、笑顔で包まれる街を、太陽工

## 太陽工業の事業

[膜構造で変わる日本の建築告示改正がもたらす建築物へのメリットと
社会課題解決への貢献][45]

[大阪・関西万博×太陽グループ太陽工業の膜構造建築×太陽グループの
イベントで実現した万博事例][46]


### 建築事業

建築に自由としなやかさを、産業に機能的で快適な空間をもたらす太陽工業の膜構造建築の製品と技術。暮らし
と社会、人と地球を明るく照らす魅力的な建築物を生み出します。

[建築事業について][47]

[


### 公共建築

スポーツ施設や庁舎、学校、福祉会館など、当社では多くの方々が利用する公共の建築物も数多く手がけていま
す。安全性の高い魅力的な建築物を実現します。

][48]
[


### 民間建築

国内外、規模や種類を問わず民間建築の豊富な実績があります。膜構造建築物のさらなる進化を追求しながら、
課題を解決し、お客様の想い描く建築物の実現に貢献します。

][49]
[


### 産業施設

テント倉庫で、機能性と効率性を兼ね備えた無柱の作業空間をお客様にご提供。建設コストや工期などの課題を
解決します。

][50]


### 海外事業

世界7大陸で事業を展開。スタジアムや国際空港、博覧会場など、数多くの建築物を手がけてきました。独自の
膜の技術で、世界と人々をつないでいきます。

[海外事業について][51]


### 物流事業

業界のリーディングカンパニーとして、長年培った豊富な経験とノウハウを活かした「品質×サービス×サポート
」を提供します。

[物流事業について][52]


### 国土事業

培ってきた膜の技術を活かし、環境保全や防災減災などに役立つ高品質の製品、工法を数多く生み出しています
。安心・安全な暮らしを支え、大切な環境を守っていくために、さまざまな課題解決に向けて積極的に取り組ん
でいます。

[国土事業について][53]

[防災製品はこちら][54]

premium, tailored-to-brand resorts, and rustic nature camps.

iconic tent architecture experience. Our custom tent projects are founded on blue sky thinking and
ground-up design, a bold approach to ultra-luxury developments.

## Project Service Process

From early drawing evaluation to fabrication and installation guidance, we support overseas project
buyers with a clear and practical workflow.
* Project drawing review
  
  ###### Our engineers review your drawings, site dimensions and basic project requirements, then
  ###### provide practical suggestions for span, height, layout and material direction.
* Design and quotation
  
  ###### Based on the confirmed project information, we provide material options, structural
  ###### direction and a reference quotation for your evaluation.
* Fabrication drawings
  
  ###### We prepare and confirm fabrication drawings with the client before production, helping
  ###### reduce misunderstanding during manufacturing and installation.
* Controlled fabrication
  
  ###### Membrane cutting, steel structure processing and related fabrication steps are arranged
  ###### according to the approved drawings and project schedule.
* Export packing
  
  ###### Finished components are packed and loaded for export, with attention to protection,
  ###### labeling and container space arrangement.
* Installation guide
  
  ###### We can provide installation guidance based on project requirements, including drawing
  ###### explanation, assembly sequence and site coordination support.

## About Timi Structure

****Guangzhou Timi Membrane Structure Co., Ltd.****, located at No. 48 Sanhe Road, Gaoming District,
Foshan City, Guangdong Province, is a large-scale membrane structure enterprise engaged in design,
development, processing, manufacturing, construction, installation, and maintenance services both
domestically and internationally. The company holds steel structure contracting qualifications and
membrane structure enterprise certification, with its own production base and advanced manufacturing
and processing equipment.

****TIMI**** specializes in the research, development, design, and production of membrane structure

## Project Service Process

From early drawing evaluation to fabrication and installation guidance, we support overseas project
buyers with a clear and practical workflow.
* Project drawing review
  
  ###### Our engineers review your drawings, site dimensions and basic project requirements, then
  ###### provide practical suggestions for span, height, layout and material direction.
* Design and quotation
  
  ###### Based on the confirmed project information, we provide material options, structural
  ###### direction and a reference quotation for your evaluation.
* Fabrication drawings
  
  ###### We prepare and confirm fabrication drawings with the client before production, helping
  ###### reduce misunderstanding during manufacturing and installation.
* Controlled fabrication
  
  ###### Membrane cutting, steel structure processing and related fabrication steps are arranged
  ###### according to the approved drawings and project schedule.
* Export packing
  
  ###### Finished components are packed and loaded for export, with attention to protection,
  ###### labeling and container space arrangement.
* Installation guide
  
  ###### We can provide installation guidance based on project requirements, including drawing
  ###### explanation, assembly sequence and site coordination support.
